meta.title: Privacy Policy — Bias Market
meta.description: How Bias Market collects, uses and protects your personal data.

sections.heading: Who we are and what the service does
paragraphs: Bias Market (biasmarket.com) is an online platform that lets creators and independent sellers, mainly of K-pop merchandise, open and run their own online stores, and lets fans browse those stores and place orders. Sellers manage products, orders and manual payment review (bank transfer, Wise, PayPal) from a dashboard. This Privacy Policy explains what personal data we collect, how we use and protect it, and the choices you have. Contact: hello@biasmarket.com.

sections.heading: Information we collect
paragraphs: Account information: your name, email address and password (stored only as a salted hash) when you register as a seller or create a buyer account.

Information from Google Sign-In: if you choose "Continue with Google", Google shares with us your name, email address, email-verified status, profile picture and Google account identifier. See "Google user data" below.
Store and order information: for sellers, store details, products, prices and images; for buyers, name, email, phone number, delivery or pickup details, and order history.
Payment proofs: images or receipts that buyers upload to show a manual payment, which are visible to the seller of that order and to us for support and fraud prevention.
Messages: information you send through contact forms or support email.
Technical information: IP address, browser and device type, pages requested and timestamps in server logs, and essential cookies that keep you signed in.

sections.heading: Google user data
paragraphs: Bias Market offers Google Sign-In for sellers. We request only the basic scopes openid, email and profile. We do not request access to Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Contacts or any other Google service.
What we access: your Google name, email address, email-verified status, profile picture URL and Google account ID.

How we use it: only to create your Bias Market account, to sign you in and to link a returning Google sign-in to the same account, to display your name and picture in your dashboard, and to contact you about your account.

Sharing: we do not sell Google user data, do not share it with advertisers or data brokers, and do not transfer it to third parties except to service providers that host our infrastructure and send our transactional emails, only as needed to run the service, or when required by law.

No advertising or AI training: we do not use Google user data for advertising, for credit or lending decisions, and we do not use it to develop, improve or train generalized artificial intelligence or machine-learning models. No human reads your Google data except for security investigations, to comply with the law, or with your consent.
Limited Use: Bias Market's use and transfer of information received from Google APIs to any other app adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

Storage and deletion: Google profile data is stored in our PostgreSQL database with the rest of your account. You can revoke Bias Market's access at any time at https://myaccount.google.com/permissions, and you can ask us to delete your account and the associated Google data by emailing hello@biasmarket.com; we delete it within 30 days, except records we must keep by law.

sections.heading: How we use your information
paragraphs: To provide and secure the service: create accounts, authenticate you, run stores, process orders and let sellers review payment proofs.
To communicate with you: verification emails, order updates, security notices and replies to your messages.
To prevent fraud, abuse and security incidents, and to enforce our Terms of Service.
To maintain and improve the platform using aggregated, non-identifying statistics.
To comply with legal obligations.
We do not sell personal data and we do not serve third-party advertising.

sections.heading: How we share information
paragraphs: Sellers: a seller sees only the buyer details, orders and payment proofs for orders placed in that seller's own store. Data from each store is separated from other stores.
Service providers: we use providers for server hosting, file storage and transactional email delivery. They process data only on our instructions and under confidentiality obligations.
Legal and safety: we may disclose information when required by law or to protect the rights, safety and security of users and the platform.
Business transfers: if Bias Market is involved in a merger or sale, data may be transferred, and we will notify you of any change in how it is handled.

sections.heading: Cookies
paragraphs: We use only essential cookies and similar storage to keep you signed in, protect your session and remember your language. We do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.

sections.heading: Data retention
paragraphs: We keep account data while your account is active. After deletion we remove or anonymize personal data within 30 days, except where we must retain records, for example order and payment records required for accounting, tax or fraud-prevention purposes.

sections.heading: Security
paragraphs: We protect data with encrypted connections (HTTPS), hashed passwords, per-store access controls and restricted access to production systems. No system is completely secure, but we work to protect your information and will notify affected users of a breach as required by law.

sections.heading: International transfers
paragraphs: Our infrastructure may process data in countries other than your own. Where required, we use appropriate safeguards for such transfers.

sections.heading: Your rights and choices
paragraphs: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, delete or export your personal data and to object to or restrict certain processing. You can update your profile in your account, revoke Google access in your Google account, or write to hello@biasmarket.com to exercise any of these rights. We respond within a reasonable time.

sections.heading: Children
paragraphs: Bias Market is not directed to children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect their personal data. If you believe a child has given us data, contact us and we will delete it.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy. The date at the top shows the latest revision, and material changes will be announced on the site or by email.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: Questions or requests about privacy: hello@biasmarket.com. Bias Market, https://biasmarket.com.

meta.title: Terms of Service — Bias Market
meta.description: The terms that govern your use of Bias Market.

sections.heading: Acceptance
paragraphs: By creating an account or using Bias Market you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

sections.heading: The service
paragraphs: Bias Market provides tools for sellers to build and run online stores, including product catalogs, orders and manual payment review (bank transfer, Wise, PayPal and similar). Bias Market is a software platform: we are not a party to sales between sellers and buyers, and we do not process or hold payments.

sections.heading: Accounts
paragraphs: You must provide accurate information and keep your credentials secure. You are responsible for activity under your account. You may sign in with email and password or with Google.

sections.heading: Seller responsibilities
paragraphs: Sellers are responsible for their products, prices, fulfillment, refunds, taxes and compliance with applicable laws, including consumer protection and intellectual property rules. Do not sell counterfeit, illegal or infringing goods.

sections.heading: Buyer responsibilities
paragraphs: Buyers must provide accurate order details and genuine proof of payment. Submitting forged or misleading payment proofs is prohibited.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
paragraphs: Do not misuse the service: no unauthorized access, scraping that harms the platform, malware, harassment, fraud, or attempts to read another store's data.

sections.heading: Content
paragraphs: You keep ownership of the content you upload. You grant us a limited license to host and display it as needed to operate the service. You are responsible for having the rights to what you upload.

sections.heading: Suspension and termination
paragraphs: We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms or put the platform or other users at risk. You may stop using the service and request account deletion at any time.

sections.heading: Disclaimers and liability
paragraphs: The service is provided "as is" without warranties. To the extent permitted by law, Bias Market is not liable for indirect or consequential damages, or for disputes between sellers and buyers.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: We may update these terms. Continued use after changes means you accept them.
